q: What carbon KPI should we give plant managers?
title: Carbon KPIs for plant managers
short: Use energy or emissions per unit of output, measured monthly, plus a data completeness target. Per unit avoids rewarding a manager for a slow month. Pair it with a few action targets, such as leaks fixed or idle hours cut, that the manager controls directly.

ul: kWh per unit and fuel per unit, monthly.
Share of fuel and electricity backed by invoices and bills.
Absolute tonnes alone, which fall when orders fall.
Targets the manager cannot influence, such as the grid factor.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
